queue.title: API Security in Business Integrations
queue.content:
A partner-facing API carries the same security risk as an internal system, but rarely gets the same scrutiny. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

An API interface open to partners carries the same security risk as an internal system, but rarely undergoes the same level of scrutiny.

An API interface open to partners carries the same security risk as an internal system, but rarely undergoes the same level of scrutiny.

Growth in the number of business integrations also means growth in the number of API interfaces exposed to external partners, each representing a potential entry point for unauthorised access.

Authentication based solely on a static API key, without rotation or scope limits, remains a common but risky practice in rapidly built integrations.

Limiting every API key to a precisely defined scope of data and operations, with regular rotation, reduces the damage of any key leak to a minimum.

Logging and regular review of API calls reveals unusual access patterns before they escalate into an actual security incident.

Cjelovit tekst i izvor: https://gnk-asg.hr/en/publications/api-security-in-business-integrations/

queue.title: Managing Exporter Bonds and Guarantees
queue.content:
A bank guarantee ties up credit even when never activated, and that hidden cost is rarely tracked. A publication by Nermin Sefić.

A bank guarantee ties up a company's credit line even when never activated, and that hidden cost is rarely tracked systematically.

A bank guarantee ties up a company's credit line even when never activated, and that hidden cost is rarely tracked systematically.

A performance or advance-payment guarantee formally isn't a cost until activated, but ties up part of a company's credit line just as real debt would.

Companies simultaneously holding multiple active guarantees toward different clients often lose track of their total tied-up exposure to banks.

A centralised register of all issued guarantees, with expiry dates and activation conditions, enables an accurate assessment of remaining credit capacity at any moment.

Timely release of expired or no-longer-needed guarantees frees up credit space for new business without requiring additional negotiations with the bank.
